by

    intro n _
    exact hf.mul_continuousOn (by fun_prop)
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finset_sum hi, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (Complex.exp _), ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  congr 2
  funext t

    rw [← Complex.exp_add]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
  rw [this]
  ring
